name: constructors and branding
source: const p=new PerformanceMark('standalone',{startTime:12});record(p instanceof PerformanceMark);record(p instanceof PerformanceEntry);record(performance instanceof Performance);record(performance instanceof EventTarget);record(p.name+':'+p.entryType+':'+p.startTime+':'+p.duration+':'+p.detail);record(performance.getEntriesByName('standalone').length);record(Object.prototype.toString.call(p));for(const fn of [()=>new Performance(),()=>new PerformanceEntry(),()=>new PerformanceMeasure(),()=>new PerformanceObserverEntryList(),()=>PerformanceMark('x'),()=>new PerformanceMark(),()=>new PerformanceObserver(3)]){try{fn()}catch(e){record(e.name)}}

name: entry ordering latest timestamp and snapshots
cloned detail including cycles and undefined
source: const data={name:'oak',nested:{value:2}};data.self=data;const p=performance.mark('detail',{startTime:1,detail:data});data.nested.value=9;record(p.detail.name+':'+p.detail.nested.value+':'+(p.detail.self===p.detail));p.detail.nested.value=3;record(performance.getEntriesByName('detail')[0].detail.nested.value);const m=performance.measure('detail-span',{start:1,end:4,detail:{a:[1,2]}});record(m.detail.a.join(','));const json=m.toJSON();record(json.navigationId===m.navigationId&&typeof json.navigationId==='number');delete json.navigationId;record(JSON.stringify(json));record('detail' in m.toJSON());for(const d of [()=>1,Symbol('x'),document]){try{performance.mark('bad',{detail:d})}catch(e){record(e.name+':'+(e instanceof DOMException))}}record(performance.getEntriesByName('bad').length);record(performance.mark('undef',{detail:undefined,startTime:3}).detail)

name: mark conversions
source: const order=[];const mark=performance.mark({toString(){order.push('name');return 'coerced'}},{get detail(){order.push('detail');return 5},get startTime(){order.push('time');return '7'}});record(order.join(','));record(mark.name+':'+mark.startTime+':'+mark.detail);for(const f of [()=>performance.mark('bad',{startTime:-1}),()=>performance.mark('bad',{startTime:NaN}),()=>performance.mark('bad',{startTime:Infinity}),()=>performance.mark('bad',{startTime:1n}),()=>performance.mark(Symbol('x')),()=>performance.mark('bad',3)]){try{f()}catch(e){record(e.name)}}record(performance.mark('zero',{startTime:null}).startTime)

name: observer tasks batching lists and this
source: const done=new Promise(resolve=>{const o=new PerformanceObserver(function(list,observer,opts){record(this===o&&observer===o);record(list instanceof PerformanceObserverEntryList);record(list.getEntries().map(e=>e.name).join(','));record(list.getEntriesByType('mark').length);record(list.getEntriesByName('a','mark')[0].startTime);record(opts.droppedEntriesCount);observer.disconnect();resolve()});o.observe({entryTypes:['mark','measure']});performance.mark('b',{startTime:20});performance.mark('a',{startTime:10});performance.measure('c',{start:30,end:40});queueMicrotask(()=>record('microtask'));record('sync')});await done

name: buffered and constructor does not notify
repeated buffered registration sorts pending snapshot
callback reentrancy queues another task
source: const done=new Promise(resolve=>{let count=0;const o=new PerformanceObserver((list,observer,opts)=>{count++;record(list.getEntries()[0].name+':'+count+':'+('droppedEntriesCount' in opts));if(count===1){performance.mark('second',{startTime:2});queueMicrotask(()=>record('between'))}else{o.disconnect();resolve()}});o.observe({type:'mark'});performance.mark('first',{startTime:1})});await done

name: disconnect cancels queued delivery without resetting mode
extended observer threshold dictionary
source: const order=[];const o=new PerformanceObserver(()=>{});try{o.observe({get buffered(){order.push('buffered');return false},get durationThreshold(){order.push('threshold');return 8},get entryTypes(){order.push('entries');return ['mark']},get type(){order.push('type');return undefined}})}catch(e){record(e.name)}record(order.join(','));try{o.observe({type:'mark',durationThreshold:Infinity})}catch(e){record(e.name)}o.disconnect()
difference: Chromium converts buffered/durationThreshold but ignores both with entryTypes; current W3C draft rejects extra known members. The engine follows the captured browser profile.
